sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the repaired applicability branching, ship ownership, waterline relationships, unit handling, declared operands, results, and DIRECT_CHECK. The applicable branch still encodes only presence of the table-selection inputs: propellerCount is any integer, propellerPitchControlType and propulsionSystemType are merely typed as classes, and engineOutputCoefficientKe has no constraint tying it to the Table 3-1 selection. Encode the required table alternatives so only propeller counts 1, 2, or 3 and the permitted pitch/propulsion combinations select the corresponding exact Ke values (using inclusive equality bounds for those regulatory constants), or otherwise provide the declared table-selection structure. Do not add a nonlinear formula execution requirement or guessed units for either resistance term.
